content.title: Are Walmart, H-E-B, Target, Kroger open on Easter Sunday in Texas? What to know
content.text: Easter Sunday is a big day for many families across Texas, whether it’s spent at church, around the dinner table or celebrating with loved ones.But when it comes to shopping, the day doesn’t always look like a typical Sunday. Depending on where you go, you may find some doors closed.Several major retailers shut down for Easter, while others remain open, sometimes with adjusted hours.That can make it harder to plan if you need to pick up groceries or grab last-minute items for an Easter basket.Here’s what to know before you head out.Yes. Walmart stores will be open on during regular hours on Easter Sunday, from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.Hours can vary by location, so it’s best to check with your local store.Is H-E-B open on Easter Sunday?No. H-E-B stores are closed on Easter Sunday. That includes curbside and home delivery services.Stores are expected to reopen at 9 a.m the following day, according to its website.Is Target open on Easter Sunday?No. Target stores are closed on Easter Sunday.The retailer is one of several major chains that shut down operations for the holiday.Is Costco open on Easter Sunday?No. Costco warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday.Easter is one of several holidays when all locations close nationwide.Is Sam’s Club open on Easter Sunday?No. Sam’s Club locations are closed on Easter Sunday, according to its website.The company follows a similar holiday schedule to Costco.Is Kroger open on Easter Sunday?Yes. Kroger stores are open on Easter Sunday and operate during regular hours, typically from 6 a.m to 11 p.m.However, pharmacy and clinic services inside stores will be closed, according to its website.Is Aldi open on Easter Sunday?No. Aldi stores are closed on Easter Sunday.The chain regularly closes for major holidays, including New Years, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.Is Whole Foods open on Easter Sunday?Yes. Most Whole Foods locations are open on Easter Sunday, but many operate on reduced hours.Check with your local store for exact closing times. Tiffani is a service journalism reporter for the Fort Worth Star-Telegram. She is part of a team of local journalists who answer reader questions about life in North Texas. Tiffani mainly writes about Texas laws and health news.
